name: Purpy Remastered
description:
Purpy Remastered is an ultra-modern, luxurious dark theme redesigned from the ground up for Minecraft server networks. With deep-space backgrounds, glass panels (glassmorphism), a dynamic color engine and high-performance components, it gives your server a premium identity.

Key Features:

  • Fully dynamic color & theme system: the main accent color you set in the admin panel is reflected instantly and 100% consistently on all glass card borders, neon auras and buttons.
  • Luxury HUD & live server status: a dual-label one-click IP copy chip, an active player counter, a voice Discord chip and a showcase event banner.
  • Advanced e-commerce & store: a dark cart table, a coupon validation panel, credit and item gift transfers, and a 3D chest delivery interface.
  • Rich community & forum: a Lexical rich text editor, category discussions, news/announcement filters and an interactive like system.
  • Support & application center: multi-step staff application forms, status badges, support ticket message bubbles and an accordion FAQ knowledge base.
  • Punishment records & rewarded voting: instantly filterable ban/mute/warn search tables and a voting system with countdown timers.
  • 100% mobile friendly: a luxurious interface that is flawlessly responsive on every screen size.
